version.changelog: L7b quality fix - VAGUE_TASK cleared, input/output sections added

llm.summary: The skill is mostly an image-scanning helper, but its broad trigger could cause sensitive files to be sent to Quark’s external service during ordinary document-processing requests.

dimensions.detail: The requested read, exec, and write tools are plausible for local image upload and result saving, but combined with the broad trigger and external upload flow they are under-scoped for generic document or conversion tasks.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No install script or bundled executable was present, but the instructions recommend permanently configuring an API key with skill-platform config or using an environment variable.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger says to use the skill for file processing, document conversion, format conversion, and content extraction, which is broader than the declared image-scan/enhancement purpose and could surprise users who did not explicitly request Quark processing.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact does not define background workers, privilege escalation, or hidden persistence; the main persistent element is the disclosed API key configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is single-image document scanning and enhancement through Quark Scan, including watermark, shadow, handwriting, background, and quality cleanup. That capability is coherent, but it necessarily involves sending user-provided images or documents to an external API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing. Use this only for explicit single-image scan or enhancement tasks, and avoid sensitive documents unless you are comfortable uploading them to Quark’s service. Keep the API key protected and rotate it if exposed.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] unexpected: Accepted in context: line 160 broadens activation to generic file processing, document conversion, format conversion, and content extraction, while the rest of the artifact describes single-image scanning/enhancement and discloses upload to Quark servers.
